items.headline: Value Creed launches RADAR data analytics tool
items.summary: Value Creed's new RADAR platform targets commodity firms' fragmented ETRM, ERP and market-data systems, aiming to turn accumulated trading data into usable intelligence per CTRM Center.

items.headline: BRAC Bank overhauls trade finance tech stack
items.summary: BRAC Bank is revamping its trade finance operations using Finastra and Conpend technology, part of a broader push by banks to modernize legacy trade finance infrastructure, per FinTech Futures.

items.headline: Hormuz tanker attack lifts oil, supply risk
items.summary: Reuters reports oil prices rose and were on track for a fourth monthly gain after a tanker attack near the Strait of Hormuz renewed concerns over seaborne supply disruption.

items.headline: EMIR REFIT shifts focus to reporting quality
items.summary: With EMIR REFIT go-live complete, regulators and firms are now scrutinizing whether derivatives reports are accurate and properly controlled, not just successfully transmitted, per EIMF Academy.
